name: Secret Spy: Operation Love
source: As the world's top special agent, your job is to save your target and yourself from a deadly plot that could end your career—permanently. You've trained from an early age to be completely untraceable, but now you've got a sassy heiress hostage, a dependable mission coordinator, and a renowned gadget expert all yearning to declassify your personal dossier. Will you remain an enigma as you travel across the globe or will you decide to reveal bits and pieces of yourself, eagerly leaving much to their imagination?
translation: 作为世界顶级特工，你的工作就是从可能永远结束你职业生涯的致命阴谋中拯救你的目标和你自己。你从小就接受了完全无法追踪的训练，但现在你有了一个时髦的女继承人人质、一个可靠的任务协调员和一个著名的小工具专家，他们都渴望解密你的个人档案。当你环游世界时，你会仍然是一个谜吗？还是你会决定透露自己的点点滴滴，急切地留下很多想象空间？
